title: The Sword of Shannara
author: Terry Brooks
summary: A half-elf youth living a quiet life in a peaceful valley learns that he alone can wield a magic sword against a dark lord. A druid sends him on a long, dangerous journey with a small band of companions.
readIf: you like old-school quest fantasy with a farm-boy hero, a wizard guide and a monster-filled road.
skipIf: you want fresh ideas; it closely follows the pattern of The Lord of the Rings.

pairings.reason: The book that Shannara is closely modelled on, with a deeper sense of history and language.
Another farm-boy-to-hero epic with a long road, though it grows into a far larger series.
A lighter and chattier quest with a similar young hero and found companions.
